entry.title: notes on plain text everything
entry.content:
Short post: plain text everything is one of those things that looks simple until it isn’t.

why it matters

Plain text everything shows up across productivity work more often than it deserves credit for. The details are small, but they compound.

what works for me

  • Make the default path the correct path so nobody has to remember the rule.
  • The fix that survives is the one the next person can understand.
  • Write it down once, link to it everywhere.

None of this is a law. It is just the shape that kept working after enough mistakes.

entry.content:
Every few months plain text everything bites me again. This is what finally stuck.

why it matters

Plain text everything shows up across productivity work more often than it deserves credit for. The details are small, but they compound.

what works for me

  • Prefer the obvious solution; clever costs interest forever.
  • The fix that survives is the one the next person can understand.
  • Start with the smallest thing that works, then make it boring on purpose.

None of this is a law. It is just the shape that kept working after enough mistakes.
